mapper.sql: (select nvl(sum(lcw.due_amount),0) from cap_financing_plan_ln pl, lon_contract_withdraw lcw where lcw.finance_plan_line_id = pl.finance_plan_line_id and pl.plan_id = cfp.plan_id and lcw.data_class = 'NORMAL')
mapper.select: SELECT cfp.confirm_status, COUNT(cfp.plan_id) plan_count, COUNT(cfp.plan_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cap_financing_plan c) * 100 plan_count_percent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cap_financing_plan a) plan_sum, (SELECT COUNT(p.plan_id) FROM cap_financing_plan p WHERE p.creation_date > (CURDATE() - DAY(CURDATE()) + 1)) AS currentMonthAppend, SUM(nvl(apply_amount,0)) apply_amount, ROUND((SUM(nvl(apply_amount,0))/(SELECT SUM(nvl(apply_amount,0)) FROM cap_financing_plan)),4)*100 ||'%' apply_amount_percent FROM cap_financing_plan cfp where cfp.data_class='NORMAL' GROUP BY cfp.confirm_status

select PLAN_STATUS, COUNT(temp.plan_id) plan_count, COUNT(temp.plan_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cap_financing_plan c) * 100 plan_count_percent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cap_financing_plan a) plan_sum, (SELECT COUNT(p.plan_id) FROM cap_financing_plan p WHERE p.creation_date > (CURDATE() - DAY(CURDATE()) + 1)) AS currentMonthAppend, SUM(nvl(temp.apply_amount,0)) apply_amount, ROUND((SUM(nvl(temp.apply_amount,0))/(SELECT SUM(nvl(temp.apply_amount,0)) FROM cap_financing_plan)),4)*100 ||'%' apply_amount_percent from ( SELECT ( CASE WHEN =0 THEN 'NONE' WHEN cfp.apply_amount - >0 THEN 'NOT_ALL' ELSE 'ALL' END) plan_status, cfp.* FROM cap_financing_plan cfp where cfp.data_class='NORMAL' ) temp GROUP BY plan_status

SELECT p.withdraw_id, p.withdraw_plan_id, lc.contract_id, lc.contract_name, lc.major_contract_number, lc.contract_number, p.withdraw_number, hbm.bp_name, fc.company_short_name, hdt.description document_type, p.due_amount finance_amount FROM lon_contract_withdraw p, lon_contract lc LEFT JOIN hls_bp_master hbm ON hbm.bp_id = lc.credit_bp_id LEFT JOIN fnd_company fc ON lc.lon_company_id = fc.company_id LEFT JOIN hls_document_type hdt ON hdt.document_type = lc.document_type AND hdt.document_category = 'LON_CONTRACT' WHERE p.contract_id = lc.contract_id AND p.data_class = 'NORMAL' and p.finance_plan_line_id = #{financePlanLineId}
